kpis.description_fr: 268 data centers dans 71 metros, 33 pays. Plus grand opérateur colocation neutre monde. Densification + nouveaux deals USA/Asie.
kpis.description_en: 268 data centers in 71 metros, 33 countries. World's largest neutral colocation operator. Densification + new US/Asia deals.

kpis.description_fr: Cabinets facturés = cabinets clients livrés et facturés. KPI core utilization. Croissance organique régulière.
kpis.description_en: Billing cabinets = customer cabinets delivered and billed. Core utilization KPI. Steady organic growth.

kpis.description_fr: MRR / cabinet = pricing power Equinix. Croissance régulière reflète mix interconnect + value-added services.
kpis.description_en: MRR / cabinet = Equinix pricing power. Steady growth reflects interconnect + value-added services mix.

kpis.description_fr: Cross-connects = connexions privées entre clients (ecosystem network effect). Cœur du moat Equinix. Marges très élevées.
kpis.description_en: Cross-connects = private connections between customers (ecosystem network effect). Equinix's moat core. Very high margins.

kpis.description_fr: xScale = JV hyperscale dédiés Big Cloud (AWS, Google, Microsoft, Meta). Croissance forte tailwind IA datacenter.
kpis.description_en: xScale = hyperscale JVs dedicated to Big Cloud (AWS, Google, Microsoft, Meta). Strong growth from AI DC tailwind.

kpis.description_fr: 95 % du CA récurrent (contrats colocation multi-an + interconnect). Visibilité revenue exceptionnelle.
kpis.description_en: 95% of revenue recurring (multi-year colocation + interconnect contracts). Exceptional revenue visibility.
